extraction_note: RGTI's 10-K names DoD/federal partners (AFRL, DARPA, NASA, DOE/Fermilab/SQMS, Innovate UK, C-DAC) but does NOT name specific Program Element numbers, specific program-of-record line items (e.g. no CCA / Skyborg / SDA Tracking Layer / specific PE codes), and does NOT quantify revenue concentration on any specific named DoD program. The substantial majority of revenue is from 'technology development contracts with various partners' (un-itemized). J-Book-grounded claims are accordingly soft / generic.
